questions.question: How much will a sum of ₹77,000 amount to after one year if the interest is compounded half-yearly at 20% per annum compound interest?
If the ratio of two numbers is 7 : 3, and their HCF is 34, then their LCM is:
7581.5 × 575.6 × 0.0881 is equal in value to:

In the table below, the number of sixes and that of batsmen who scored them is given. Study the table and answer the question that follows.						Number of sixes			Number of batsmen							1			3							2			4							3			2							4			1							5			3			What is the median of the number of sixes?
If x is inversely proportional to y, and y = 14 when x = 8, find the value of x, when y = 28.
In what ratio must a grocer mix two varieties of rice costing ₹157 and ₹105/kg, respectively, to get a mixture of rice worth ₹114/kg?

Sohan borrows a sum of ₹8,06,465 at the rate of 20% per annum simple interest. At the end of the first year, he repays ₹25,590 towards return of principal amount borrowed. If Sohan clears all pending dues at the end of the second year, including interest payment that accrued during the first year, how much does he pay at the end of the second year?
A and B together can complete a task in 12 days. If A alone can finish it in 20 days, how long will B alone take to finish the task?

A supplier offers a trade discount of 15% on the list price of ₹10,000. Additionally, a cash discount of 5% is offered if payment is made within 10 days. What is the final price to be paid if the buyer avails both discounts?
Sachin purchased 10 kg of rice at the rate of ₹36 per kg and 40 kg of rice at ₹44 per kg. He sold the whole mixture at the rate of ₹42 per kg. Find his loss (in ₹).

A train travels a distance of 360 km. For the first 120 km, it travels at a speed of 60 km/hr. For the next 180 km, it travels at a speed of 90 km/hr. For the remaining distance, it travels at a speed of 120 km/hr. What is the average speed of the train for the entire journey (in km/hr)?
A shopkeeper marks an article at ₹x and offers a discount of 20% on it. He sells it for ₹461 after charging VAT of 25% on the discounted price. What is the value of x?

Prashant and Nisha have to travel from Delhi to Kanpur in their respective cars. Prashant is driving at 57 km/hr while Nisha is driving at 33 km/hr. Find the time taken by Nisha to reach Kanpur if Prashant takes 11 hours.
A is 50% more efficient than B. Working together, they can complete a job in 20 days. How long would B alone take to complete the same job?

A car runs for the first 375 km at an average speed of 50 km/hr, the next 315 km at an average speed of 70 km/hr and the next 575 km at an average speed of 57.5 km/hr. What is the average speed (in km/hr) for the entire journey?
After applying a 15% discount, the selling price of a product is ₹850. Determine the marked price.
If the cost price of an item is equal to 96% of its selling price, then what is the profit percentage? (Rounded up to two decimal places)
Three numbers are in the ratio 1 : 2 : 3 and the sum of their cubes is 333396. The greatest of the three numbers is:

An empty cistern can be filled by three pipes A, B and C in 15 minutes, 20 minutes and 25 minutes, respectively. A fourth pipe can empty the full cistern in 12 minutes. If all the pipes are turned on simultaneously, in how much time (in minutes to the nearest integer) will the empty cistern be full?
A shopkeeper sold a book at a loss of 6%. If the selling price had been increased by ₹456, there would have been a gain of 18%. What was the cost price (in ₹) of the book?
